supporting_observations.claim: Near the alert time, FILE-HD-01 made connections to the explicit proxy on port 8080. The listed connections at 13:45:24, 13:45:36, and 13:47:10 have orig_bytes values of 1851, 616, and 2668 respectively; these records do not identify an external destination or document a hundreds-of-MB transfer.

The supplied evidence does not establish which process or service, if any, performed the alerted transfer; the nearby proxy connection records alone cannot attribute it to the approved backup agent or to malicious activity.

known_telemetry_limitations: Collection-status metadata reports winsec and sysmon outages on FILE-HD-01 from 13:30 to 14:10 UTC, and a proxy-log outage on PROXY-HD-01 over the same interval.
The provided records do not include an event that identifies the destination, process, or transferred data for the reported large outbound transfer.
claims_not_established: Whether the transfer reached the approved cobaltvault.net backup service or an unapproved destination.
Whether cvagent.exe, another authorized process, or an unknown process initiated the transfer.
The exact flow, volume, and content of the alerted transfer, and whether it completed.
Whether the scheduled svc-claimsync password rotation or subsequent job update is related to the alert.
additional_evidence_needed: The original network alert details and associated flow records, including timestamps, destination IP/domain, byte counts, and connection outcome.
Proxy access logs for PROXY-HD-01 covering 13:20–14:20 UTC, especially the reported transfer interval.

FILE-HD-01 process, service, and application logs for the interval, including CobaltVault agent and ClaimSync job activity; recover or independently collect records missing during the outage if possible.
Firewall, egress, or other network-flow records that can independently identify the transfer destination and volume.
Change or job-execution records confirming the svc-claimsync rotation and manual update timing.
unrelated_findings: Separate review: PROXY-HD-01 connected to FILE-HD-01 over SMB at 13:39:43; this record does not establish a connection to the alerted outbound transfer (T010-00251).

Separate review: DC-HD-01 made an unsuccessful connection attempt to FILE-HD-01 port 22, followed by a rejected connection to port 8443 after the alert time; these are outside the alerted transfer and do not determine its disposition (T010-00445, T010-00452).
